out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a potted plant in the ware wash handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed the potted plant.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw beef over produce and dough in the walk in cooler and raw beef kabob over prepared vegetables in three door flat top.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC relocated the foods during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device in the true two door prep tops (left) /(right): hummus (45 F), baba ganoush (44 F), sour cream (46 F), cut tomato (43 F), tzatziki (47 F)/ shredded cheese (48 F), cut tomato (46 F), grounded raw beef (45 -46F); cheesecake (47 F), honey cake (61 F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC relocated all the foods to the reach in freezer for rapid cooling down to 41 F. PIC adjusted the temperatures of the units

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: tzatziki, tomato sauce in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Please ensure all foods prepared and held for more than 24 hours are date marked by the follow up inspection. EHS re-educated.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator: insect bait powder on the floor under the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS re-educated. Please ensure removal from establishment by the follow up inspection. FELAH VILLAGE CHANTILLY (Inspection Date: 09/01/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Please ensure to have it by the follow up inspection.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the 3-door flat top cooler (right)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: dry goods in bulk containers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over the right side of the 3-comp sink in the ware wash where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Re-locate the device by the follow up inspection

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed packaged soda bottles in the prep area and boxed produce in the WIC on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC re-located food items.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths were observed stored on the prep counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC re-located wiping clothes to sanitizer buckets. FELAH VILLAGE CHANTILLY (Inspection Date: 09/01/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Ice cream scoops improperly stored in water of 73 F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC relocated the utensils to an empty container.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: dough sheeter, ice cream freezer and not NSF or equivalent approved.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. Please provide the specifications of the equipment to verify NSF or equivalent certification of equipment or remove the equipment by the follow up inspection within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. No thermometer available for testing temperature of water used for sanitization for the high temp dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Please provide by follow up inspection within 10 days.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH and QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.
